description:
Welcome to Monday Electric –Dallas’s #1  Master electrician for emergency electrical repairs and troubleshooting power issues that other electricians can’t solve.

Based in Dallas , I specialize in fast, expert diagnosis of problems like flickering lights, tripping breakers, mystery power loss, burning electrical smells, and outlets that stop working without warning.

Subscribe for real job walk-throughs, emergency call footage, electrical tips, and behind-the-scenes shorts that show what it’s really like fixing the toughest electrical problems in Indiana homes.
